items.title: A $300,000 Portfolio in NNN REIT, Vail Resorts and UPS Pays $17,814 a Year in Dividends. Here’s What Happens if One Cuts
items.summary: Key TakeawaysA $300,000 portfolio split evenly across NNN REIT, Vail Resorts and UPS pays about $17,800 a year in dividends, or about $1,480 a month, at today’s prices. NNN REIT’s dividend looks the safest of the three, taking 69% of its AFFO in fiscal 2025 after 37 straight years of raises.
